headline: Bluesky expands AI tool for building social apps
summary: Bluesky expanded its AI-powered Attie tool, which first launched to build custom feeds, to let users build games, polls, dashboards and websites that can be shared with the social network's audience.

claims.statement: Bluesky expanded its AI-powered Attie tool to let users build games, apps and websites to share on the network.

sources.quote: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
Bluesky’s AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social

claims.statement: Attie initially launched earlier this year as a tool to build custom feeds using AI.

sources.quote: Bluesky's Attie AI tool, which initially launched earlier this year as a way to use AI to build your own feeds

claims.statement: Bluesky describes the feature as bringing 'social vibe coding' to the Attie platform.

sources.quote: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform

claims.statement: Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider discussed the feature in an interview at TechCrunch Disrupt.

sources.quote: In an interview at TechCrunch Disrupt, Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider said
